customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (seed uuid or content hash).

full_name.meaning: Customer's full legal name as on the government photo ID presented at first move-in; for a business profile, the authorized contact's name.

phone_number.meaning: Primary mobile number on the profile; a verification credential.

email.meaning: Email address on the profile, lower case; a verification credential and the delivery address for e-notices.

date_of_birth.meaning: Date of birth of the person on the profile; a verification credential.

drivers_license_last4.format: 4 characters, the last four of the government photo ID number
drivers_license_last4.meaning: Last four characters of the government photo ID recorded at first move-in; a verification credential.

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the profile's billing address; a verification credential.

mailing_address.meaning: Mailing address where lien and rate notices are sent by mail.

customer_since.meaning: Date the customer profile was opened.

customer_type.meaning: Whether the profile belongs to an individual or a business tenant.

business_name.meaning: Registered business name for a business profile; empty for individuals.

alternate_contact_name.meaning: Alternate contact named on the rental agreement to receive copies of lien notices; empty if none was given.

alternate_contact_phone.meaning: Phone number of the alternate contact; empty if none.

military_status.meaning: Military status recorded on the profile from documents the customer provided; active_duty requires orders on file.

facility_space_id.meaning: Primary id of one rentable unit or parking space in facility inventory.

facility_code.format: three-letter metro code, hyphen, three-digit store number (e.g. DEN-014)
facility_code.meaning: Facility where the space is located.

space_number.meaning: Unit or space number as posted at the facility (e.g. B117, P-22).

values: Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft)
Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft)
Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft)
Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft)
space_class.meaning: Official class name of the unit or parking space.

space_size.meaning: Dimensions in feet, width x depth (e.g. 10x15, 12x45).

street_rate.meaning: Posted monthly rate a new tenant pays for this space today, before discounts.

availability.meaning: Current inventory state of the space as kept by the facility.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the verification record (content hash of the customer id).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; never goes back from true to false.

verified_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record (content hash of customer id and reason).

customer_id.meaning: Customer handed to a human representative (-> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

rental_id.meaning: Primary id of the storage unit rental agreement.

variant_name.meaning: Unit class of the unit currently on the agreement, official full name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the agreement (see the unit charter lifecycle).

facility_code.format: three-letter metro code, hyphen, three-digit store number (e.g. DEN-014)
facility_code.meaning: Facility where the unit is located.

unit_number.meaning: Unit number currently on the agreement, as posted at the facility.

unit_size.meaning: Dimensions of the unit in feet, width x depth.

monthly_rent.meaning: Contracted monthly rent before any discount; changed only by a rent change or transfer.

move_in_date.meaning: Date the agreement was signed and possession began; empty while reserved.

billing_day.meaning: Day of month rent falls due (the move-in day; months without that day fall due on their last day).

balance_due.meaning: Current amount owed; identically the sum of rent_balance deltas on the ledger (charges positive, payments and credits negative); negative means a credit balance.

deposit_held.meaning: Security deposit currently held; identically the sum of security_deposit deltas.

delinquent_since.meaning: Due date of the oldest unpaid billing period of the current delinquency cycle; empty while the rental is current.

last_rate_change_date.meaning: Effective date of the most recent rent change or rate-clock reset; the move-in date if the rent has never changed.

coverage_source.meaning: How the tenant meets the contents coverage requirement.

lock_status.meaning: Current lock on the unit door.

military_discount_applied.meaning: Whether the standing military discount applies to this agreement (attached at reservation on proof of service).

move_out_date.meaning: Planned vacate date while moving_out; the actual vacate or lien-sale date once ended; empty otherwise.

entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one tenant ledger entry.

rental_id.meaning: Rental agreement the entry is posted to (-> unit_rentals).

event_type.meaning: Ledger event family of the entry.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; the direction comes from the event family (charges, reversals and refunds raise the balance; payments, credits and proceeds lower it; deposit entries move the deposit held).

period_start.meaning: Due date (first day) of the billing period a rent charge or fee relates to; empty for payments, credits and deposit entries.

period_end.meaning: Last day of the billing period of a rent charge; empty otherwise.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of fee on a unit_fee_charge entry; empty on other entries.

credit_type.meaning: Kind of credit on a unit_credit entry; empty on other entries.

reference_entry_id.meaning: Ledger entry this entry arises from or applies against (rent charge behind a late fee, payment behind a reversal or returned-payment fee, charge being waived or corrected); empty when none.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a payment (prepaid_rent_plan = a month applied from a Bluegate prepaid plan); empty on other entries.

payment_channel.meaning: Where a unit_payment was taken; empty on other entries.

autopay_draft_id.meaning: AutoPay draft behind an autopay payment (-> autopay_drafts); empty for one-time payments.

reversal_reason.meaning: Why a payment was reversed; empty on other entries.

refund_method.meaning: How a unit_refund was paid; empty on other entries.

release_type.meaning: How a portion of the deposit was released; empty on other entries.

lien_action_id.meaning: Primary id of one lien-process step.

delinquency_anchor_date.meaning: Due date of the oldest unpaid period of the delinquency cycle the step belongs to (the rental's delinquent_since at the time).

notice_method.meaning: How the step's notice was delivered; none for physical steps and holds.

scheduled_sale_date.meaning: Lien sale date set by a sale_advertised step; empty otherwise.

hold_reason.meaning: Reason for a lien_hold_placed or lien_hold_released step; none otherwise.

rate_change_id.meaning: Primary id of one noticed rent change.

new_rent.meaning: Monthly rent from the effective date.

notice_date.meaning: Date the notice was sent or the concession granted.

effective_date.meaning: Rent due date from which new_rent applies.

source_rate_change_id.meaning: The increase notice a concession or rescission modifies (-> unit_rate_changes); empty for an increase.

transfer_id.meaning: Primary id of one unit transfer.

from_variant_name.meaning: Unit class of the unit left.

variant_name.meaning: Unit class of the new unit.

monthly_rent.meaning: Monthly rent on the new unit (its street rate on the transfer date).

transfer_fee_amount.meaning: Transfer fee charged; 0.00 when the class left carries none.

moveout_notice_id.meaning: Primary id of a tenant's move-out notice.

planned_vacate_date.meaning: Vacate date set by the notice under the notice-period rule.

notice_status.meaning: Status of the notice: received until vacate is confirmed (completed) or the tenant withdraws it.

refund_method.meaning: How the tenant asked any credit balance to be returned.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

plan_id.meaning: Primary id of the tenant protection plan.

rental_id.meaning: Storage unit rental agreement the plan protects (-> unit_rentals).

variant_name.meaning: Coverage level currently on the plan record, official full name (a requested change shows here only once it has taken effect).

coverage_limit.meaning: Coverage limit of the level on the record.

monthly_fee.meaning: Monthly protection fee of the level on the record.

deductible.meaning: Deductible of the level on the record.

last_change_date.meaning: Effective date of the most recent coverage level change; empty if never changed.

lapse_date.meaning: Date of the current lapse; empty when not lapsed.

cancellation_date.meaning: Date a cancellation took effect; empty otherwise.

termination_date.meaning: Date the plan terminated; empty otherwise.

premium_balance_due.meaning: Protection fees currently owed; identically the sum of premium_balance deltas; negative means a credit.

claims_paid_total.meaning: Net claim money paid on the plan to date; identically the sum of claims_paid deltas.

premium_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one protection fee ledger entry.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; direction comes from the event family (charges and refunds raise the fee balance, collections and credits lower it).

period_start.meaning: Start of the billing period a fee charge or collection relates to; empty for credits and refunds.

credit_type.meaning: Kind of credit on a protect_premium_credit entry; empty otherwise.

reference_entry_id.meaning: Fee charge a credit applies to (-> protect_premiums); empty otherwise.

refund_method.meaning: How a refund was paid; empty otherwise.

plan_change_id.meaning: Primary id of one coverage level change.

request_date.meaning: Date the tenant asked for the change.

change_direction.meaning: Whether the coverage limit goes up or down.

effective_date.meaning: Date the new level applies to new losses.

claim_event_id.meaning: Primary id of one claim handling event.

plan_id.meaning: Plan the claim is under (-> protect_plans).

claim_id.meaning: Claim the event belongs to (-> protect_claims).

event_date.meaning: Date of the request, decision, payment or void.

requested_document.meaning: Document asked for on a document request; empty otherwise.

decision.meaning: Outcome of a decision; empty otherwise.

denial_reason.meaning: Controlled reason behind a denial or partial approval; none for a full approval; empty on non-decision events.

amount.meaning: Approved amount on a decision, paid amount on a payment, voided amount on a void; empty on document requests.

claim_payment_method.meaning: How a claim payment was issued; empty otherwise.

reference_event_id.meaning: Claim payment a void reverses (-> protect_claim_events); empty otherwise.

void_reason.meaning: Why a payment was voided; empty otherwise.

assessed_general_value.meaning: On an assessment, the adjuster's actual cash value of general household property in the loss. Empty on other events.

assessed_jewelry_value.meaning: On an assessment, the adjuster's actual cash value of jewelry, furs and watches. Empty on other events.

assessed_electronics_value.meaning: On an assessment, the adjuster's actual cash value of electronics. Empty on other events.

assessed_collectibles_value.meaning: On an assessment, the adjuster's actual cash value of collectibles and art. Empty on other events.

assessed_firearms_value.meaning: On an assessment, the adjuster's actual cash value of firearms. Empty on other events.

assessed_business_inventory_value.meaning: On an assessment, the adjuster's actual cash value of business inventory, tools and equipment. Empty on other events.

claim_id.meaning: Primary id of a protection claim filed by the tenant.

rental_id.meaning: Unit where the loss happened (-> unit_rentals).

loss_date.meaning: Date the loss occurred as established by the police report or facility record; the discovery date when the occurrence date cannot be fixed.

discovery_date.meaning: Date the tenant discovered the loss.

peril.meaning: Cause of loss as stated on the claim.

police_report_number.meaning: Police report number exactly as the tenant gives it; empty if none.

police_report_date.meaning: Date the police report was filed; empty if none.

forced_entry_evidence.meaning: Forced-entry evidence recorded by the facility at inspection.

facility_incident_reference.meaning: Facility work-order number logging a building or climate-control failure behind the loss, entered by facility staff; empty if none.

documents_on_file.meaning: Comma-separated list of document codes received (same codes as requested_document), as logged by the claims desk.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

cancel_request_id.meaning: Primary id of a tenant request to cancel protection.

insurer_name.meaning: Tenant's own insurer exactly as stated; empty for a pending_effective plan.

insurer_policy_number.meaning: Tenant's own policy number exactly as stated; empty for a pending_effective plan.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

parking_rental_id.meaning: Primary id of the parking space agreement.

values: Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft)
Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft)
Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft)

variant_name.meaning: Space class on the agreement, official full name.

facility_code.format: three-letter metro code, hyphen, three-digit store number (e.g. PHX-031)

space_number.meaning: Space number as posted at the facility (e.g. P-22).

start_date.meaning: Date the agreement started (first due date); empty while reserved.

billing_day.meaning: Day of month rent falls due.

balance_due.meaning: Amount owed; identically the sum of parking_balance deltas; negative is a credit balance.

delinquent_since.meaning: Due date of the oldest unpaid period of the current delinquency cycle; empty while current.

last_rate_change_date.meaning: Effective date of the most recent rent change; the start date if never changed (a rescission does not change it).

vehicle_type.meaning: Type of the vehicle on file.

vehicle_length_ft.meaning: Overall length of the vehicle on file, including tongue and outboard motor.

vehicle_plate.meaning: Plate or hull registration number of the vehicle on file, as printed.

registration_expiry.meaning: Expiry date of the registration on file.

insurance_expiry.meaning: Expiry date of the liability insurance on file.

military_discount_applied.meaning: Whether the standing military discount applies.

move_out_date.meaning: Planned vacate date while moving_out; actual vacate or tow date once ended; empty otherwise.

parking_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one parking ledger entry.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; direction comes from the event family (charges, reversals and refunds raise the balance; payments and credits lower it).

period_start.meaning: Due date of the billing period a rent charge or fee relates to; empty for payments and credits.

period_end.meaning: Last day of the billing period of a rent charge; empty otherwise.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of fee; empty on other entries.

credit_type.meaning: Kind of credit; empty on other entries.

reference_entry_id.meaning: Entry this entry arises from or applies against; empty when none.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a payment (prepaid_rent_plan = a month applied from a Bluegate prepaid plan); empty on other entries.

payment_channel.meaning: Where a payment was taken; empty on other entries.

autopay_draft_id.meaning: AutoPay draft behind an autopay payment (-> autopay_drafts); empty otherwise.

reversal_reason.meaning: Why a payment was reversed; empty otherwise.

refund_method.meaning: How a refund was paid; empty otherwise.

parking_notice_id.meaning: Primary id of one notice on a parking agreement.

cycle_anchor_date.meaning: Date the notice cycle runs from (delinquency date, expiry or inspection date, or the compliance notice date for a termination).

cure_by_date.meaning: Date by which the problem must be cured or the vehicle removed; empty for a gate lockout.

parking_rate_change_id.meaning: Primary id of one noticed parking rent change.

new_rent.meaning: Monthly rent from the effective date.

street_rate_at_notice.meaning: Posted street rate of the space on the notice date.

tenure_months_at_notice.meaning: Whole calendar months from the start date to the notice date.

effective_date.meaning: Rent due date from which new_rent applies.

source_rate_change_id.meaning: Increase a concession or rescission modifies (-> parking_rate_changes); empty for an increase.

parking_moveout_notice_id.meaning: Primary id of a parking move-out notice.

planned_vacate_date.meaning: Vacate date set by the notice.

refund_method.meaning: How any credit balance is to be returned.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()

truck_rental_id.meaning: Primary id of the truck rental contract (reservation through close).

facility_code.format: three-letter metro code, hyphen, three-digit store number (e.g. AUS-007)

scheduled_return_date.meaning: Scheduled return date (moved by an agreed extension).

linked_rental_id.meaning: Storage unit rental the free move-in truck is claimed for (-> unit_rentals); empty when not claimed.

actual_pickup_date.meaning: Date the vehicle left the lot; empty before pickup.

actual_pickup_time.meaning: Time the vehicle left the lot.

truck_unit_number.meaning: Fleet number of the vehicle handed over (e.g. TX-26114).

fuel_out_eighths.meaning: Fuel at pickup, eighths of a tank.

deposit_method.meaning: Card type the deposit hold is on.

actual_return_date.meaning: Date checked in; empty before return.

fuel_in_eighths.meaning: Fuel at return, eighths of a tank.

closed_date.meaning: Date the contract closed; empty otherwise.

balance_due.meaning: Amount owed; identically the sum of truck_balance deltas.

deposit_hold_amount.meaning: Hold currently on the card; identically the sum of deposit_hold deltas.

truck_charge_id.meaning: Primary id of one truck contract ledger entry.

charge_type.meaning: Kind of charge on a truck_charge entry; empty otherwise.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; direction from the event family.

service_date.meaning: Date the charge, payment, credit, hold or release relates to.

quantity.meaning: Units charged (miles, eighths, hours, periods, items); empty where not applicable.

reference_id.meaning: Source record: the incident for a damage or toll charge, the charge being credited; empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; empty otherwise.

release_type.meaning: Kind of hold release; empty otherwise.

truck_incident_id.meaning: Primary id of one incident on a truck contract.

incident_date.meaning: Date of the incident or its discovery.

incident_reference.meaning: Damage estimate number, roadside case number or toll and citation notice number as issued.

damage_location.meaning: Where the damage is; none for non-damage incidents.

repair_estimate_usd.meaning: Fleet shop repair estimate; for a toll or citation, the amount passed through; 0.00 for a breakdown.

waiver_void_reason.meaning: Why a waiver does not apply; none when it applies or no waiver was taken.

autopay_id.meaning: Primary id of one AutoPay authorization.

agreement_id.meaning: Agreement drafted for (-> unit_rentals.rental_id or parking_rentals.parking_rental_id per agreement_kind).

method_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the card or bank account.

card_expiry.meaning: Card expiry as printed; empty for bank accounts.

account_holder_name.meaning: Name on the card or bank account exactly as stated.

verified_date.meaning: Date verification passed; empty until then.

first_draft_due_date.meaning: First due date drafted under the cutoff rule; empty until verified.

next_draft_due_date.meaning: Next due date this authorization will draft, kept by the billing system; empty once ended.

suspension_date.meaning: Date of the current suspension; empty when not suspended.

suspension_reason.meaning: Why suspended; empty when not suspended.

reinstated_date.meaning: Date of the latest reinstatement; empty if never.

cancellation_date.meaning: Date the authorization ended; empty while in force.

end_reason.meaning: Why the authorization ended; empty while in force.

autopay_draft_id.meaning: Primary id of one draft attempt or return.

due_date.meaning: Rent due date the draft is for; empty on a return.

draft_date.meaning: Date submitted, or for a return the date received.

attempt_number.meaning: Attempt number for the due date; empty on a return.

amount.meaning: Amount drafted or returned (0.00 when skipped).

result.meaning: Outcome of a draft attempt; empty on a return.

reference_draft_id.meaning: Draft a return reverses, or a retry follows (-> autopay_drafts); empty on a first attempt.

return_code.meaning: Return code or chargeback reason; empty on a draft attempt.

autopay_notice_id.meaning: Primary id of one AutoPay notice.

notified_amount.meaning: Amount the tenant is told will be drafted (varying-amount notices only); empty otherwise.

prepay_id.meaning: Primary id of one prepaid rent plan.

agreement_id.meaning: Agreement covered (-> unit_rentals.rental_id or parking_rentals.parking_rental_id per agreement_kind).

paid_date.meaning: Date the prepayment was received; empty while pending.

term_end_date.meaning: Last day of the term (the day before the first due date after the term).

locked_monthly_rent.meaning: Monthly rent locked for the term, before plan discount.

prepaid_balance.meaning: Unused prepaid credit; identically the sum of prepaid_credit deltas.

ended_date.meaning: Date the plan completed, terminated, was forfeited or cancelled; empty otherwise.

prepay_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of one prepaid plan ledger entry.

agreement_kind.meaning: Kind of agreement the plan covers.

amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places, always positive or 0.00
amount.meaning: Entry amount; the prepayment raises the credit, applications, refunds and forfeiture applications lower it.

period_start.meaning: Due date of the billing period a month was applied to; empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: How the prepayment was paid; empty otherwise.

refund_reason.meaning: Why a refund was issued; empty otherwise.

business_account_id.meaning: Primary id of a business storage account.

invoice_balance.meaning: Amount owed on account invoices; identically the sum of business_receivable deltas.

past_due_since.meaning: Due date of the oldest unpaid invoice while on credit hold; empty otherwise.

closure_date.meaning: Date closed or declined; empty otherwise.

business_invoice_id.meaning: Primary id of one business account ledger entry.

invoice_month.meaning: Invoice month the entry belongs to.

amount.meaning: Entry amount; invoices and charges raise the balance, payments and credits lower it.

entry_date.meaning: Invoice date, service date, payment date or credit date.

service_type.meaning: Kind of service charge; empty otherwise.

quantity.meaning: Units charged; empty where not applicable.

reference_id.meaning: Source record (delivery, invoice entry or credited line); empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; empty otherwise.

business_delivery_id.meaning: Primary id of one delivery handling record.

tracking_number.meaning: Tracking or pro number exactly as on the label.

billable.meaning: Whether the receipt is chargeable (beyond the monthly allowance, or a pallet).
